offer.text: I can't map what I can't see. Climb to the mountains and take in the lay of the land for me.

accept.text: From a peak you can see for leagues. Go carefully on the climb.

decline.text: The highlands stay a blank on my map, then.

in_progress.text: Have you reached the peaks yet?

ready.text: You've stood on the roof of the world! Tell me what you saw.

complete.text: The mountains are charted at last. Wonderful work.
